breakdown.description: The prompt computes reduction of area from a diameter ratio instead of from the initial and final cross-sectional areas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the diameter-based formula 100 × (d₀ − d_f) / d₀ instead of the correct area-based formula using initial and final cross-sectional areas. This repeats the original error rather than fixing it.

breakdown.description: The prompt uses the final gage length in the denominator for percent elongation, whereas percent elongation is referenced to the original gage length.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses L_f in the denominator for percent elongation (100 × (L_f − L₀) / L_f), repeating the original error. The correct formula uses L₀ in the denominator.
